description: Return the exact x402 payment requirements (price, payTo, asset, network, input schema) for one a-un product, so an x402-capable client can pay and call it. Use before buying. Without an endpoint it returns the requirements of every product.

endpoint.description: Product path, full URL, key or name, e.g. /x402/web-read, https://a-upgradenet.com/x402/memory-health or web.read. Get valid values from list_products. Omit it to get every product.

name: get_payment_requirements
title: Get x402 payment requirements
